scores.note: Negation warn: 'do not really need' becomes 'unnecessary'/'misuse'/'unneeded', which keeps the meaning in 1-3. Options 4 and 5 drop the 'not needed' claim and narrow it to colds/viruses, which were only an example. Option 1 'misuse' is broader; option 3 drops 'antibiotics' and reads awkwardly.
